Class AssignmentsService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.AssignmentsService
@Service public class AssignmentsService extends Object
What the admin Assignments page and the rankings CSV have in common (issue #179): which applicants count, how they are identified, which sections appear in which order, and how many applicants are tentatively assigned to each section.

  • Method Details

    • identityColumns

      public static List<AssignmentsService.IdentityColumn> identityColumns(RecruitmentType type)
      The identity columns for a recruitment's type: the common four, class level for TAs, year in program and graduation date, then GPAs and previous ULA service for ULAs. No video links, middle names or admin comments.

    • courseNumber

      public static String courseNumber(String courseId)
      The course number without its subject: everything after the first run of whitespace in the stored course id, so "CMPSC 5A" is "5A" and "CMPSC 16" is "16" (issue #188). A null id, or one with no whitespace at all, gives "".

    • headings

      public static Map<Long,String> headings(List<RecruitmentCourse> courses)
      How each section is headed in the Rankings CSV (issue #188), keyed by recruitment course id: the bare course number, plus " (section S)" only when the export has more than one section of that course, and ", enroll E" inside the parentheses only in the odd case of two rows with the same course and section.

    • preference

      public static String preference(Application application, String courseId)
      How interested an applicant is in a course: their first or second choice, or the interest they marked for it, or null when they marked nothing or "Not Interested/Not Applicable" (the default answer, never stored).

    • realApplications

      public List<Application> realApplications(Long recruitmentId)

    • assignments

      public AssignmentsService.Assignments assignments(Recruitment recruitment)
      The sections and applicants of the Assignments page. Every section not removed is a column; a removed section is kept only while it still has rankings or a tentative assignee, so nothing faculty entered disappears from view.
